metadata.description: Manual annotations, image metadata, data partitions, trained detector weights (YOLOv12n, Cascade R-CNN, RT-DETR-L), detector outputs, and the Calibration-set images (8,229 HabCam images) used to develop and evaluate a two-stage generalized additive model (GAM) calibration of automated Atlantic sea scallop counts from benthic imagery (Georges Bank and Mid-Atlantic Bight, 2022–2024 and 2026). Also includes the independent 2026 survey test: YOLOv12n weights trained on 2022–2024 only, applied to every annotated 2026 image. See README.md for file and column descriptions.
